Ahead of the White Friday Protest at the EDSA Shrine, Akbayan Partylist reiterated its call for Congress to remove all Unprogrammed Appropriations from the 2026 National Budget.

The House of Representatives is expected to approve the General Appropriations Bill today on 2nd Reading, amid Akbayan’s warning that the ₱43 billion fund risks becoming a black hole for corruption if left unchecked and urged lawmakers to demonstrate genuine commitment to transparency and accountability.

“₱243 billion ang pondong nakatago sa Unprogrammed Allocations. Karapatan ng taumbayan na malaman kung saan mapupunta ang kanilang binabayad na buwis,” said Akbayan President Rafaela David. “Ang Unprogrammed Allocation ay parang ‘secret pocket’ ng gobyerno na pinopondohan ng taumbayan. Hindi malinaw kung para kanino at para saan ang pondo, at pwede nilang paghugutan ng pera kung kailan at para saan nila gusto.”
